research_question: Do sparse completed one-second bursts of extreme native XAUUSD quote-revision intensity carry persistent directional information that survives independent P75 executable costs?

sources.name: Gençay, Mahmoodzadeh, Rojček & Tseng — Price Impact and Bursts in Liquidity Provision
sources.reconstruction: Brief episodes of extremely high quote arrival/revision intensity have material price impact, approximately five times non-burst periods; reported burst duration is about 1.09 seconds.

sources.name: Russell & Engle — Forecasting the Frequency of Changes in Quoted Foreign Exchange Prices with the ACD Model
sources.reconstruction: FX quote-change intensity is an economically meaningful state variable in irregular tick time; repeated quotes can be thinned to focus on actual price revisions.

source_qa.approximation_note: The published burst paper does not expose an exchange-portable universal intensity cutoff in the surfaced public text. This prereg uses a fixed robust statistical extreme criterion, not an XAUUSD-tuned percentile.

event_grammar.binning: completed UTC 1-second bins, matching the approximately 1.09-second burst duration reported in source literature
event_grammar.revision_count: count native snapshots in the second for which ask or bid differs from the immediately prior snapshot
event_grammar.event_start: current completed second is extreme and immediately previous completed second was not extreme
event_grammar.direction: sign of native midquote displacement from first to last revision inside the completed burst second
event_grammar.entry: first P75 tick at or after burst-second right edge, in burst displacement direction
event_grammar.same_burst_dedup: consecutive extreme seconds form one burst; only first extreme second can signal

profiles.rule: single preregistered continuation interpretation; no fade variant in this unit

evaluation.economics: frozen DELTA 30-second initial-hold engine; fixed 0.01 lot; P75 executable quote side; stop 300 raw; trail activation 100; trail distance 30; max hold 30s; $0.01 entry + $0.01 exit commission

anti_overfit: If C01 fails executable economics, retire QRBM.
